strategies.name: R4-C (our main plan)
strategies.kid: Our best plan. Over a year of pretend trading it grew $1,000 to about $1,150, and the worst dip along the way was about 8%.

strategies.name: R3 (no chop filter)
strategies.kid: The same plan without its safety filter. It lost about $140 on every $1,000. The real-money bot uses rules close to this one.

strategies.name: Test A
strategies.kid: Lost money, about the same as R3.

strategies.name: Test D
strategies.kid: Its dips were small, but it traded about 32 times a year, which is far more than your limit of about 15.

strategies.name: Test R1
strategies.kid: Came out exactly the same as R3, so its extra rule never actually did anything.

live.status: Checking which rules it uses against its real trades

notes: The testing tool had a bug that faked some losses. It's fixed, and every test was re-run.
Every test here uses pretend money. Only the live bot uses real money.
Next up is a fairer test: tune each plan on older data, then check it on data it has never seen.
